summary.name: HideNotch
summary.one_liner: HideNotch is a free, open-source macOS 26 app that paints the menu bar black on notched MacBooks so the notch blends into the screen.
use_cases: hide the MacBook notch from the screen
make the menu bar look uniform on a notched display
match notch and non-notch external displays
install a macOS menu bar utility via Homebrew
summary.what_it_does: HideNotch turns the macOS menu bar black on notched MacBooks so the notch blends in, and it can be toggled on and off from the menu bar. It has an optional setting to round the screen corners, which can be turned off if only the black bar is wanted. The same look can be applied to external displays that have no notch. The app runs without a Dock icon, can start at login, and its menu bar icon can be hidden. The page lists installation via a DMG download from GitHub or a Homebrew cask.
notable: Paints the menu bar black so the notch blends in
Works on external displays without a notch
No Dock icon; can start at login or hide menu bar icon
